title: WsProtocol
description: Root of the schema: one property per direction, so every type lands in `$defs` once.

Agent.description:
Token legs and the estimated cost of one table row. `cost_usd` is `None` when no model in
the row has a price: `-` in the table, `null` in JSON, never `$0.00` (that means free).

coverage.description:
`both` only: `through_rtok_tokens` over the logs' tokens, so an agent that bypasses
the proxy reads low. `None` when the logs hold no tokens for it.

through_rtok_tokens.description: `both` only: tokens of this agent that also passed through rtok.

Alert.description:
One raised alert, as stored and as `rtok graph projects --json` and `rtok doctor --json`
print it.

since.description: Unix seconds of the check that raised it.

CallBatch.description:
What one poll found, as one frame. `summary` counts every event of the poll (including
the ones left out of `events`), so a page that adds summaries up never undercounts a burst.

events.description:
Newest last. A call's start and progress events are left out when its end is in the
batch, since the end carries the same call and tool.

head.description: The newest event id the batch covers.

omitted.description: Events cut because the batch held more than [`MAX_EVENTS`] (the oldest go first).

CallRow.description:
One `calls` row as the Calls page serves it ([`Store::recent_calls`], T15.5): the
ledger's own columns plus the slugs its ids point at and — when the call is one
that recorded usage — the newest `usage` row linked to it. One query's output, so
no renderer can re-derive a field differently (D27); `api` `None` means no usage
row is linked (a hook, MCP call or plugin run carries none).

caps.description: Rows with a `ref_id`: answers cut at `max_tokens`.

crossed.description: Ended calls whose scope held more than one project.

est_before.description: Sums of the `samples` of the end events: the `Measurement` columns `rtok stats` adds up.

fallbacks.description:
`lsp_fallback` rows of the ended calls: each is one answer the tags index gave after the
language server could not.

symbols.description: Symbols the ended calls asked for.

Capability.description: One project's record, as stored and as `rtok graph projects --json` prints it.

config.description: The `backend` value the record was made under; another value makes it stale.

down.description:
The server was installed and working, then broke. Unlike a server that was never there,
this is what the health check raises "backend down" for.

language.description: The project's language when it has a marker file.

next_probe_at.description: When the health check retries a failed record; absent while the server answers.

reason.description: Why the server does not answer; absent while it does.

server.description: The language has a language server at all, installed or not.

CardKind.description: One junk kind under an agent.

Chosen.description: The mode that answers a project's requests.

ClientMessage.description: A message a client sends over `/ws`.

anyOf.description: Ask for the archived payload behind an archive id.
Change the project registry (T329.12, T329.20): select a project, or link two of them.
The `doctor --fix` checklist: plan it, or write it once the user confirmed.
"Clear safe junk" on the Hosts page: plan it, or remove once the user confirmed.
The inside of one project for the graph page's level 2 (T329.14); read-only.

Start or stop the graph call events (T329.15); the page subscribes while the live
graph is visible, so a hidden one costs nothing.

Components.description: Each component is 0 to 1, rounded to two places.

oneOf.description: Return the items and the diff; nothing is written.
Write the selection: the page sends this only after its confirmation.

more.description: Nodes left out by the cap.

partial.description: Some files changed since the last index run, so the picture lags the tree.

project.description: The project that owns the node: the one asked for, or the linked one for `external`.

stale.description: The file changed since the last index run.

weight.description: Edge count through the node; the page sizes it by this.

oneOf.description: A symbol of a linked project: `project` says which.

focus.description: A symbol shown with its callers and callees.

limit.description: Nodes shown before "+N more"; the page raises it on a click.

project.description: An id or a root path, as in `rtok graph projects`.

query.description: Finds symbols in the project and its scope.

code.description: 1 when a selected entry was skipped or failed.

GraphEvent.description:
One event of a graph call. `call` ties a call's events together; `ts_ms`, `id` and the
clipping of free text are the store's, so a writer leaves `id` and `ts_ms` at zero.

answer_tokens.description: Estimated tokens of the answer the caller received (end events).

backend.description: `lsp`, `tags` or `text`: the backend that answered (end events).

done.description: Scope members done and in total (progress and end events).

samples.description: The call's `graph` measurement rows (end events); empty when the answer was not shortened.

symbols.description: Symbols the call asked for (every event); `None` for a tool that takes none.

can_keep.description: Whether this copy may be made the kept one.

kept_in.description: The file that holds the copy kept instead, for a duplicate.

label.description: What the entry runs or is called.

shared.description: In a project's shared file: starts unselected.

oneOf.description: Return the dry run; nothing is removed.
Remove the confirmed paths: the page sends this only after its confirmation.

JunkCard.description: The `junk` card of the Hosts page.

paths.description:
For `apply`: the paths of the plan the user was shown. A planned item not named here
stays, so nothing that appeared since the plan goes unseen.

oneOf.description: The first index has not finished; there is no score yet.

MeasurementSample.description:
One `measurements` row of the call, with the columns `rtok stats` sums. Copied from the
table at the call's end, so a page that adds these up gets the report's numbers.

ref_id.description:
Set when the row's answer was cut and archived: how a page tells a cap hit from an
`explore` row that only stands for several smaller calls. Absent in rows written before T329.33.

ModelRow.description:
Token legs and the estimated cost of one table row. `cost_usd` is `None` when no model in
the row has a price: `-` in the table, `null` in JSON, never `$0.00` (that means free).

ModuleRow.description:
One [`MODULES`] row of a host variant: its state and the note printed after it — the flag
that would install it, or the reason it cannot be installed.

Origin.description: How a project got into the registry (T329 §1).

Overview.description:
The Overview page (T15.3): the usage totals plus what the tab draws from them —
context-token-turns and the per-turn series behind the sparkline. The totals stay
flat under the `usage` key, so the `/ws` frame keeps the shape P19 pinned and the
SPA reads on untouched.

alerts.description:
Persistent operator warnings for the whole disabled period (e.g. proxy plain
mode). Empty when none; omitted from the wire when empty so the P19 shape stays.

ctt.description:
Σ over sessions of Σ over turns `ctx × turns-after`, where `ctx` is the turn's
input-side tokens (`input + cache_create + cache_read`) and `turns-after` counts
the session's later turns — the usage-row mirror of `stats`' `tokens × remain`.
Output is left out on purpose: it re-enters as a later turn's input or cache,
so counting it again would count it twice.

savings.description:
The Δtok trend Overview and Stats draw: [`SAVINGS_DAYS`] days ending today, oldest
first, from [`savings_trend`]. Empty while the first read runs or when the store will
not read.

turns.description:
Per-turn `ctx`, sessions oldest-first and request order within a session, kept
to the last [`OVERVIEW_TURNS`]. A `usage` row carries no timestamp, so across
sessions this is session order, not wall-clock order.

Period.description:
Token legs and the estimated cost of one table row. `cost_usd` is `None` when no model in
the row has a price: `-` in the table, `null` in JSON, never `$0.00` (that means free).

diff.description: The diff of every file the selection would change.

refused.description: Selected entries the engine will not remove, with why.

Planned.description: One item of the plan and what happened to it.

action.description: `clear` (removed, or would be on a dry run) or `skip`.

failed.description: Planned and not removed: the re-check refused it or the removal failed.

last_used.description: Unix seconds of the newest file in it; `None` when unreadable (T330.6).

planned.description: In the plan: false for an item left at planning time (a running agent's).

reason.description: Why it is junk, as `list` says it.

PluginPage.description:
A plugin's page: its manifest, the static copy it contributes through
`Plugin::dashboard_page`, and the stats widget when it saves tokens.

Problem.description: One finding of a doctor config check. The list is shared by every T331 detector.

command.description: The command as written, never expanded.

group.description: Copies of one duplicate share a `group`; `keep` marks the copy to keep (T331.3).

path.description: The key path of the entry inside `source`.

source.description: The config file the entry lives in.

ProjectIndex.description:
`graph status` numbers for one project; absent for a missing root, which has nothing
readable to count.

ProjectLink.description: One outgoing link of a project.

ProjectRequest.description:
The registry writes the graph page offers; `<project>` is an id or a
root path, as in `rtok graph projects`.

ProjectRow.description: One registry row as `graph projects` prints it and the `/ws` snapshot carries it.

alerts.description: What the health check raised for this project (T329.17); absent while nothing is wrong.

backend.description:
Which graph mode works here, as the last process to answer for it recorded (T329.11);
absent until a request under `lsp` or `auto` has checked.

health.description: The 0 to 100 health score with its components, reasons and fixes (T329.19).

scope_health.description:
The lowest score in this project's scope (itself and what it links to); absent while
every member is still on its first index.

ReadShare.description:
Share of Read-class transcript tokens spent in native Grep/Glob (T50.4):
`(grep + glob) / (read + grep + glob)` by estimated tokens. `None` when the
transcripts hold no Read-class results — the default stays off on no data.

Reason.description: What lowered a component, and what to do about it.

Ref.description: An entry as the page names it: the file and the key path inside it.

agents.description: Every host variant and the state of each rtok module in it, as `agent setup` prints.

graph_alerts.description:
What the graph health check raised for linked projects: missing, unreachable, backend
down, link broken (T329.17). Read from the store the checking processes write.

graph_health.description:
Projects whose graph health score is under 80, weakest first, with reasons and fixes
(T329.19).

instructions.description:
The instruction audit (T7.2): `Some` only when `[doctor] instructions` ran — an audit
that found nothing still prints its section header, as it always did.

mcp.description: One probed MCP server: name, command, tool count, description tokens.

mcp_tool_search_disabled.description:
MCP tool search is not confirmed on: `mcp_tool_search.state` is `disabled`, or `unknown`
with a custom `ANTHROPIC_BASE_URL` (the heuristic).

overlaps.description:
Host-native features that duplicate a running rtok surface (T59.7), each
naming the rtok config key that turns the duplicate side off. Advice: the
lines say "duplicate", never "saves N".

problems.description: Hooks that lead nowhere or cannot be checked (T331.1); the list later detectors extend.

proxy.description: The proxy chain behind `ANTHROPIC_BASE_URL`, hops joined with `→`.

proxy_openai.description: The proxy chain behind the OpenAI seed (`OPENAI_BASE_URL` or a host config).

read_share.description: Read-class token share from the transcripts (`None` = no data, fail open).

skills.description: The skills audit (T61.3): `Some` when the probe ran; an empty tree prints no section.

models.description: `--by model` only: the model rows the middle table shows instead of `agents`.

skipped.description: Hosts whose files exist but could not be read: named, counted nowhere.

through.description: The last day with usage, in `tz`.

unpriced_models.description: Distinct model ids without a price.

SavingsDay.description: One day of the Δtok savings trend (T414.13).

day.description: `YYYY-MM-DD` in `[agents.usage] tz`, so the trend and the Usage page cut the same days.

plugins.description:
The same per plugin, only the plugins with rows that day. An `expand` row nets negative,
as on the Plugins page.

saved.description:
Σ est_before − est_after; `None` when the day has no rows. No row, no saving claim: an
empty day is a gap on the chart, never a zero.

score.description: Absent while the project's first index runs.

Selection.description: What the user changed since the defaults.

keep.description: Entries made the kept copy of their duplicate.

toggled.description: Entries whose selection is the opposite of their default.

ServerFrame.description: A frame the server pushes besides the [`Snapshot`] itself.

oneOf.description: A one-line notice for the operator (refused key, failed `set`, unknown archive id).
The archived payload a client asked for with [`ClientMessage::Expand`].
The checklist of `rtok doctor --fix` and the diff of the selection (T331.12).

The dry run of "clear safe junk" (T330.7): what `agents junk clear` would remove for every
agent; nothing was removed.
What a confirmed junk apply removed.
The answer to [`ClientMessage::Graph`]: one project's nodes and edges (T329.14).

What the graph tools did since the last frame (T329.15): sent only after
[`ClientMessage::Calls`] subscribed, at most four times a second.

SessionTotals.description:
One session's totals ([`Store::session_totals`], T25.1) — the rendering input of the
Sessions page and `rtok agent sessions` (T25.2). Everything below is one query's
output, so no renderer can re-derive a number differently (D27): tokens are whole-
session sums of `usage`, `last_activity` is the MAX ts over the session's `usage`
and `calls` rows (falling back to `started_at` when there are none), and `ended_at`
`None` means live.

SkillDuplicate.description: One skill name listed from several places (T392).

copies.description: `(source, directory)` of every listing, in root order.

extra_tokens.description: Description tokens the extra listings add to every request.

identical.description: Every body is the same text; a differing body is the case the model cannot tell apart.

SkillRepeat.description: A skill body re-sent into the same context window (T392).

tokens.description: Estimated tokens of the repeated bodies.

invocations.description: Invocations in the last 30 d from the T61.1 fold; `None` = no data.

warn_body.description: Body over 8 KB — almost always a `references/` candidate.

warn_desc.description: `description:` over [`SKILL_DESC_MAX`], the cap rtok's own skills follow.

warn_never.description: Listed but never invoked in the window (only when data exists).

SkillsAudit.description:
The skills audit (T61.3): what the host lists and what it costs the system
prompt. Advice only — nothing here edits a file.

desc_bytes.description: Description bytes the listing rides with every request (≈ tokens/4).

duplicates.description:
Names reachable from more than one real path (T392). Advice only: rtok never deletes a
skill it does not own.

repeats.description: Skills loaded again with no compaction between, from the transcripts (T392).

SkillsPage.description: Skills page (T63.1, D23): one row per skill the host lists.

header.description: Totals: listed, desc bytes ≈ tokens/req (chars/4, research.md §10.2), resident, input share.

Skipped.description: A host whose session files exist but could not be read: named once, counted nowhere.

Snapshot.description:
Everything a surface needs for one refresh. `Default` is the empty frame a surface
paints while its first read is still running.

agent_usage.description:
Usage page (T358.5): what `rtok agents usage` reports, through [`usage_page`]. The
overview's own `usage` key is the proxy's totals, so this one carries the page's name
in its own words.

calls.description: Calls page (T15.5): the last [`CALLS_ROWS`] ledger rows, newest first.

config.description:
Config page (T228): `rtok config show --sources`'s rows, through
[`config_page_text`] (D27, no second layering). `None` on a failed tick.

doctor.description:
Doctor page (T15.6): what `rtok doctor` reports — hooks, MCP servers, proxy
chains. `None` when this tick's probes failed; the page renders the failure
rather than zeros, the way an unreadable store renders an empty page.

error.description:
Set when the store will not open or this tick's doctor probe failed (T60.6). Both
surfaces render it as a banner instead of an empty page.

graph.description:
Graph page (T230): `graph status`'s index health (rows, files, the T68.3
pending/staleness set, `indexed_at`) plus `graph dead`'s unreferenced-definition
list, folded into one page (D27) — [`graph_page_text`], read from the store on
this tick (no re-indexing). `None` when the `graph` feature is off or the store
read failed.

hosts.description:
Hosts page (T231): `agents list`'s blocks — kind, detected version, installed
surfaces, config path — one per known host variant (D27), so `agents list` /
`agents info` can join `COMMAND_PAGES`. [`hosts_page_text`] reuses the same
probe `agents_list`'s JSON form calls (T168's `--version` noise filter and all)
behind a cache: never blocks a 2 s tick on a cold or stale probe — the tick
renders the last known text, or "probing hosts…" before the first one lands.

junk.description:
The Hosts page's junk card (T330.7): the numbers of the `junk` section of `hosts`, as data
([`junk_page`] reads the one cached report). `None` while the first measurement runs.

logs.description:
Logs page (T15.7): the last `[log] lines` log lines, newest first — the same
selection `rtok logs` screens ([`Model::log_lines`], T15.11). Riding the snapshot
makes the page both surfaces' (D23); `[log] lines` is the frame's bound too.

plugins.description: Plugins page: one entry per catalogue plugin.

projects.description:
Project registry (T329.12): every registered project with its index state and links,
the same rows `rtok graph projects --json` prints. `None` when the `graph` feature is
off or the store read failed.

ref_ids.description:
Archive ids keyed by `calls[].id` (T60.4). Both surfaces read this map; neither
queries the store for an expand handle (D23 / D27).

services.description:
Services page (T229): `demon status`'s per-service rows plus `otel status`'s
exporter health, through [`services_page_text`] (D27, no second reader —
[`Model::demon`] and [`otel_status`] already build both). `None` on a failed
tick.

sessions.description: Sessions page (T25.1): one row per session, newest first.

skills.description: Skills page (T63.1): T61.3 listing joined to T61.1 resident/invocations.

stats.description:
Stats page (T227): `stats --price`'s table plus `stats --cache`'s table, folded
into one page (D27) — [`stats_page_text`], built from the same transcript scan
[`stats_skills`] already runs for the Skills page (no second aggregation). `None`
when this tick's transcripts read failed.

usage.description: Overview page: provider usage totals, CTT and the per-turn series.

worktrees.description:
Worktrees page (T232): `worktree list`'s rows — path, branch, owner, age,
`target/` size and state — through [`worktrees_page_text`], the same
[`crate::worktree::list::rows`]/[`crate::worktree::list::to_table`] `worktree
list` already calls (D27, no second reader or directory walk); `gc`/`clean`
stay CLI-only verdicts. `None` only when the current directory is unreadable.

Stats.description: The shared stats widget: `usage` rows for the overview, `Measurement` rows per plugin.

ToolSearch.description:
The tool-search state and where it came from; `source` is `None` for the default (nothing to
report), so a plain install prints no line.

ToolSearchState.description: Whether Claude Code defers MCP tools (T388).

oneOf.description:
No `ENABLE_TOOL_SEARCH` override, but a custom `ANTHROPIC_BASE_URL`: Claude Code falls back
to loading tools upfront unless the proxy forwards `tool_reference` blocks, which rtok
cannot see from here.

Totals.description:
Token legs and the estimated cost of one table row. `cost_usd` is `None` when no model in
the row has a price: `-` in the table, `null` in JSON, never `$0.00` (that means free).

daily_rows.description: Distinct `(agent, day)` pairs with usage, what ccusage calls daily rows.

UsagePage.description:
The Usage page: one [`usage::Report`] — the call `rtok agents usage` makes — read once and
carried twice. `text` is that command's screen ([`usage::Report::to_text`]) for the tui and
the SPA's status line; `report` is the same rows as data for the SPA's tables. Nothing is summed
a second time (D27). Both are empty-handed while the first read runs or after it fails:
`report` is `None` and `text` says why.

Weak.description: One project under [`NOTICE_BELOW`], as `rtok doctor` lists it.
